conviction_note: The stock has been a merger-arbitrage instrument since 7 Aug 2026. It is pinned 9% below the €2.556 recesso (withdrawal) value, and its daily moves since then have been about 0.9% against −15.6% and +7.2% on the last two pre-merger prints. So a half-year that is new but probably weak (Q1 revenue −29%, mobility orders delayed) is sized small and slightly negative. abs 2.5 reflects the anchor, which sets both the floor and the cap. p_up 45 because flat closes are common at a €0.005 tick on a €2.33 stock.

already_public.what: Q1 2026 revenue €41.5m (−29% y/y), mobility weakness, and a 2026 mobility market described as 'più complesso'. Q1 also disclosed group adjusted net debt of €243.0m, liquidity of €35.4m, overdue trade payables of €39.2m and the MIMIT IPCEI receivable of €177.9m excluded from net debt.

FY2025: financial covenants breached at 31 Dec 2025 on the Seri Industrial-CDP, Seri Industrial-Unicredit and FIB-pool revolver loans, with waivers under negotiation. Revenue €373m, adjusted net debt €227m.
Eni Industrial Evolution buys 30% of the FIB commercial vehicle (FAENIX) for a fixed €55m, closing within 5 days of 29 May, so the cash lands inside H1

Merger into the unlisted parent SE.R.I. S.p.A. (56.378%) for delisting. Exchange ratio 1.9167 SERI shares per share. Recesso value €2.556. EGM 12 Nov 2026. The parent-level (holding) balance sheet at 30 Apr 2026 was published.
London Financial Guarantees filed a petition for liquidazione giudiziale (judicial liquidation) against Seri Industrial and FIB over a disputed €8m claim. The company calls it manifestly unfounded.

new_in_release.expect: H1 2026 group revenue, EBITDA and loss are new. Revenue is likely below H1 2025's €149.6m: Q1 was −16.9m y/y, and Q2 2025 was a strong bus quarter (€91.2m). The loss is likely wider. Leans negative, but the recesso anchor mutes it.

Net debt at 30 June is new. The Eni €55m is public, so its inflow is expected. Whether any of the €177.9m MIMIT IPCEI grant receivable was collected is unknown. A collection would be positive for the credit of whoever pays the recesso.

Covenant waiver status, and any going-concern ('continuità aziendale') emphasis in the auditor's limited review, given the LFG petition. Direction unknown; this is the one tail that could widen the recesso spread.
The company gives no numeric guidance, and a delisting company is unlikely to start now. The 2026-2030 business plan was 'in preparation' at FY25; if it appears, it is the upside tail. Unknown.

bar: unsourced: 1 analyst (baseline consensus.analyst_count 1, Yahoo quoteSummary shows no quarters) and no company guidance. Sized against prior-year H1 revenue of €149.6m (https://seri-industrial.it/download/seri-industrial-s-p-a-board-of-directors-approves-results-as-of-june-2025/?wpdmdl=8718) as a reference, not an expectation. Every size is capped small.
session_check: amc. The board meets 29 Sep 2026 per the issuer's calendar (https://www.seri-industrial.it/index.php/calendario-finanziario) and Borsa Italiana's CDA_today.pdf as of 28/09/2026 ('29/09/2026 - SERI INDUSTRIAL Relazione Semestrale', https://www.borsaitaliana.it/azioni/documenti/calendariobilancidividendi/CDA_today.pdf). The issuer releases board outcomes after the close. The Q1 2026 revenue release was covered by Teleborsa at 2026-04-23T19:48+02:00 (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/04/23/seri-industrial-ricavi-trimestrali-scendono-a-41-5-milioni-di-euro-pesa-divisione-mobilita-281.html). The merger release was 'diffuso ieri sera a mercato chiuso' (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/08/07/seri-industrial-crolla-in-borsa-su-piano-per-fusione-nella-controllante-e-delisting-81.html). The H1 2025 release (board 29 Sep 2025) is datelined 30 Sep 2025 and was first covered at 05:29 UTC on 30 Sep (https://www.soldionline.it/notizie/azioni-italia/conti-seri-industrial-primo-semestre-2025). So the scored window is close(2026-09-29) -> close(2026-09-30), not the sealed bmo window, which will contain no release.
positioning_check: CONSOB register read as of 2026-09-25 (https://www.consob.it/documents/11973/395154/PncPubbl.xlsx/fbefe0a2-795b-bad3-9369-beccbeb14f27) and does not name the issuer. That is the 0.5% truncation floor, not a measurement (anchor_covered false), and the change is not known. No positioning anchor: priced_lean_pct +0.085 is the run-up term. The real positioning is merger arbitrage: holders who do not vote for the merger get €2.556 cash at the merger's effectiveness, 9.9% above the €2.325 spot.

findings.finding: H1 2026 revenue and the loss are new to the market and probably weak. Q1 revenue fell 29% (mobility −67%), and management flagged delayed public bus orders and cassa integrazione (state-funded furlough) at Menarini. So H1 revenue is likely below H1 2025's €149.6m. But the stock has traded as a claim on the €2.556 recesso since 7 Aug, which mutes an operating miss to a small spread-widening.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Before the merger, the Q1 2026 revenue print (released 23 Apr evening) was sold −15.6% on 24 Apr 2026, and FY2025 got +7.2% on 20 Apr 2026 (Yahoo SERI.MI daily closes). Since the 6 Aug merger announcement, closes have ranged 2.295–2.415 with 20d realised vol of 14% annualised, so the anchor dominates.
findings.original_quote: Il Gruppo nel corso del primo trimestre 2026 ha realizzato Ricavi pari ad euro 41.500 migliaia registrando una riduzione [...] per il 2026 relativamente alla Divisione Mobilità Sostenibile, si prevede un contesto di mercato caratterizzato da maggiore complessità (In Q1 2026 the group posted revenue of €41.5m, a decline [...] for 2026, for the Sustainable Mobility division, a more complex market context is expected)
findings.why_not_priced: Only Q1 is public, and there is no consensus: 1 analyst, no estimates on Yahoo. If H1 weakness were priced beyond the recesso discount, the spread to €2.556 would have widened into the print. Instead the stock has held 2.30–2.36 for three weeks. The finding is sized small because the recesso anchor, not the operating number, sets the price; that is the 'in a live bid, results are noise' case.
findings.independence: The FY2025 release independently describes the mobility slowdown and cassa integrazione ('attivando ammortizzatori sociali'): https://seri-industrial.it/download/il-consiglio-di-amministrazione-approva-i-risultati-al-31-dicembre-2025/?wpdmdl=10552 (same issuer, a different document).

outside_window.finding: First hearing on LFG's petition for liquidazione giudiziale against Seri Industrial and FIB (claim €8m, disputed), per MF: 'Il 20 ottobre [...] si terrà la prima udienza'
The court-appointed expert (RSM) opinion on the fairness of the exchange ratio, and the merger documentation made available before the vote

EGM on the merger into SE.R.I. S.p.A. and the start of the recesso window at €2.556 (spot €2.325, 9.9% spread). SE.R.I. holds 56.378%, so approval turns on minority turnout at the two-thirds-of-represented-capital threshold.
Hearing for final submissions (precisazione delle conclusioni) in the LFG payment-order opposition

searched_and_found_nothing: Any postponement of the 29 Sep 2026 board meeting: none on the issuer's 2026 press-release page (https://seri-industrial.it/comunicati-stampa-2026/) and Borsa Italiana's CDA_today.pdf still lists 29/09 as of 28/09. The 2025 H1 board had been moved from 25 to 29 Sep (https://seri-industrial.it/download/modification-of-the-2025-corporate-financial-calendar-2/?wpdmdl=8710); the legal deadline is 30 Sep.
Any H1 2026 revenue pre-release or MAR 'informazione privilegiata' since 6 Aug: none found on the issuer site or Teleborsa.

Any 2026 collection of the €177.9m MIMIT IPCEI grant receivable: only the 2024 disbursement news came back (https://www.websim.it/azioni/small-mid-cap/notizie/seri-industrial-contributi-per-teverola-2/, dated 2024-11-26).
eMarket STORAGE day archive for 2025-09-29 and 2025-09-30: 67 and 83 rows read with no Seri row, so the issuer does not file through eMarket STORAGE and the release cannot be timestamped there.

Whether the merger is conditioned on a recesso cap: not in the 6 Aug release or the integrated 2501-quinquies report (https://seri-industrial.it/download/relazione-integrata-ex-2501-quinquies-cod-civ-di-seri-industrial-sul-progetto-di-fusione/?wpdmdl=11263); no cap found.
baseline_tension: It agrees. The run-up is flat (20d −1.69%, 5d −1.27%), the lean is +0.085, and the finding is small and negative. The real tension is with the history scale: the 3.29% pre-merger cadence median and the −15.6%/+7.2% last prints no longer describe a stock pinned to a fixed-price recesso claim.
language_note: The issuer's Italian calendar and Borsa Italiana's CDA_today.pdf confirmed the 29 Sep board date. English results gave only a vendor calendar row.
Teleborsa's 'diffuso ieri sera a mercato chiuso' and its 19:48 CEST timestamp on the Q1 release settled the session as amc. No English source carried release timing.

The Italian Q1 2026 release carries the CONSOB art. 114 supplementary disclosure (net debt €243m, overdue payables €39.2m, IPCEI receivable €177.9m outside net debt). The English Q1 wire (Globe/TipRanks) carried revenue only.
The Italian FY2025 release discloses the covenant breaches on the CDP, Unicredit and FIB-pool loans and the waivers under negotiation; no English source found carried this.
The London Financial Guarantees petition for liquidazione giudiziale (1 Sep and 4 Sep releases) and MF's 20 Oct hearing date appear only in Italian sources.

The recesso mechanics came from the Italian merger release and 2501-quinquies report: who qualifies, continuous holding from the EGM, efficacy subject to the merger deed. English wires carried only the headline ratio and price.
lessons_applied: 'In a live bid, results are noise ... the offer is the finding': confirmed the framing that the recesso anchor, not the operating print, sets the price. The revenue finding went from −0.4 to −0.25.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': dropped the +0.1 Eni €55m liquidity finding, because the fixed consideration and its closing date were public on 29 May.

'Understatement is the systematic error; size on what is new': abs_move raised from 2.0 to 2.5 because H1 numbers and covenant/going-concern language are genuinely new. It is held well below the 7% base because of the anchor.

'Session check ... open with the verdict and a timestamp': session_check now opens with 'amc' and cites the Teleborsa timestamps. p_up nudged from 42 to 45, so the sum stays consistent with (2p−1)·abs.
'A truncated zero is not evidence nobody is short': positioning_check states anchor_covered false explicitly.
